title: Numeral odometer roll (Springs)
source: springs.estate stat blocks (extracted pin-less from stat-odometer). Engine = library/components/numeral-odometer-roll (proven, owns_pin:false). NO engine patch needed.
engine: A vertical strip of numerals in a one-number-tall overflow:hidden window; the column translateY so the active value sits in frame — the number ROLLS. Pure set(p) maps across the value sequence.
differs: Same roll mechanic (translateY the column) + same pure set(p). TRIGGER differs: desktop scrubs set(p) from scroll while the stat pins (reversible); mobile cycles set(p) 0→1→0 over time on its own (auto-play). Springs mobile shows the stat as an auto beat, not a scroll-pin.

desktop.driver: scrollRoll — p = scroll progress across the stat span (reversible).

mobile.driver: autoRoll — p cycles 0→1→0 over cycleMs each way, eased, looped.

values.what: the value sequence the odometer rolls through.

digits.what: pad each value to N chars.

cycleMs.what: duration of one roll (up) in the auto loop.

engine_patch: NONE — this engine has no narrow-guard and owns_pin:false; set(p) is pure translateY at any width. The simplest module in batch A.
entry: NumeralOdometerRollDual.init(target, opts) -> { platform, engine, driver }. Load engine.js THEN component.js. Markup: .nor-window > .nor-col (engine builds .nor-num rows from values).
law: translateY (the column) only; overflow:hidden window; tabular-nums; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop / NO WebGL / NO width/height animation. reduced-motion → rest on final value.
